decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The details as shown on submitted drawing numbers 2515/15 and 2515/16 are acceptable in showing the position and design of the refuse storage area.  The Council is satisfied that the details would cause no harm to the appearance of the site, cause no harm to neighbours' living conditions, and the refuse be collected from the site provided that the access at the rear of the site as approved is implemented. The details are in line with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), and C.1.2 (New Religious Meeting Places) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Following approval for the erection of two storey Hindu Centre, incorporating Hindu temple and two storey annexe building, linked by two storey covered walkway, with ancillary car parking details submitted pursuant to Condition 9 (Refuse) of approved planning permission reference 01501/A/P2 dated 16/12/99.
